messages:
lina-csm: Quick sync — MeridianRx requests a short regional lift for an investor demo next Friday. They want an APAC allowlist and a temporary token-rate increase. Trial renewal in 9 days, flagging for renewal playbook.
devin-support: Can we do a 4-hour window, QPS 50->200, and allowlist 203.0.114.0/24? They also asked for pre-demo cache seeding for top-8 prefixes 30m prior.
arch-hugo: Confirmed feasible. Need sample prompt set and rough seq len distribution. We'll seed prefixes using the warmup worker; expect slight latency bump during seed.
ops-mei: Netops checklist: staging preferred. Need account id, region tag, and formal justification for audit. I'll create scheduled revoke. netops-bot please queue revoke.
lina-csm: account: meridian-rx (acct-mer-2109). staging tenancy. justification: investor demo + sales POC. Message attached to ticket MER-2109-DEMO.
arch-hugo: Plan:
1) add allowlist 203.0.114.0/24 to apac-staging-proxy
2) bump qps 50->200 for acct-mer-2109 during window
3) seed top-8 prefixes at T-30m (seed job id seed-331000)
4) enable detailed traces and s3 log dump to customer bucket (14d retention)
ops-mei: Scheduling now. netops-bot: create revoke job and link audit.
netops-bot: @ops-mei revoke_job=rev-331000 scheduled at 2026-06-12T06:05Z. Audit ticket MER-2109-DEMO attached.
ops-mei: APPLY DONE — allowlist added, qps bumped, seed job queued id=seed-331000. Logs delivery staged. Please validate with Meridian.
devin-support: Meridian reports fewer 429s; seed caused ~25ms latency increase for ~8 minutes then normalized. All good.
lina-csm: I'll add demo success to renewal playbook and ask for feedback on caching TTLs. Devin, please collect post-demo telemetry and upload to the renewal notes.
devin-support: Will do. Setting alert: if 5xx > 0.5% over 5m rollback early.
arch-hugo: We'll monitor KV hit ratio and revoke early if anomalies. Closing loop after telemetry arrives.
lina-csm: thanks team! :tada:
